d:
A passage in Sonia Gandhi’s new book Belonging: A Journey of Love has triggered a controversy over Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s childhood tragedy. Sonia writes that Kharge’s family was killed during caste riots when their house was set on fire. But in a June 2026 interview, Kharge himself recalled that Razakars had attacked his village and set his home ablaze, killing his mother and other family members. Why does the book not mention the Razakars? What happened to Kharge’s family in 1948? Here’s the story behind the controversy.
